title: Do You Need Trail Running Shoes? Grip, Protection & Fit
claims: 坚硬岩石路面适合约 3–4 mm 短齿，强调黏性橡胶、鞋头保护与灵活鞋底。
混合全地形适合约 4–5 mm 中齿与多方向抓地。
Lugs of 5 mm and above are for muddy ground; on hard ground they feel unstable and wear faster.

verification.note: 正文含按地形分列的齿深表。

claimVerification.note: 表格首行："Short lugs (around 3 to 4mm)… Sticky rubber, toe protection, a flexible sole"。
表格第二行："Medium lugs (around 4 to 5mm)… Multidirectional grip"。
原文 “Tall lugs (5mm and above)”；硬地不稳/磨损更快有原文支持。把 6 mm 改为 5 mm。
